item.title: Idiomatic Code
item.description:
You can call it “beautiful code” when the code also makes it look like the language was made for the problem - Ward Cunningham

If you have a sound continuous integration practice, your pull requests will be automatically evaluated for test coverage and compliance with code conventions. But it’s your teammates who will evaluate the degree to which the submitted code is high quality through being idiomatic. What does this mean?

item.title: Manage the Marbles with Dagger Producers
item.description:
TL;DR in composing pipelines of asynchronous tasks we encounter the same kinds of problems as in composing graphs of dependencies.

The dependency injection framework Dagger 2 can manage both types of composition, leading to increased modularity.
